# telnyx_global_ip_health_checks (Data Source)

Lists global ip health checks, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_global_ip_health_check`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `global_ip_health_checks` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--global_ip_health_checks))

<a id="nestedatt--global_ip_health_checks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `global_ip_health_checks`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was created.
- `global_ip_id` (String) Global IP ID.
- `health_check_params` (String) A Global IP health check params. A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `health_check_type` (String) The Global IP health check type.
- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of the resource.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was updated.
